name: Private Messages
description: Private chat between members, Telegram style: live messages, instant sending, read receipts, edit and recall, real delete, Persian texts and Jalali dates, full screen on phones, blocking. Administrators can read conversations (logged).
author: flatbb

min_posts.label: Posts a member needs before sending messages
min_posts.help: Administrators and moderators can always send.

per_hour.label: Messages a member may send per hour (0 = no limit)

edit_minutes.label: A message can be edited for (minutes, 0 = never)

recall_minutes.label: A message can be recalled for (minutes, 0 = never)
recall_minutes.help: Recalling removes the text for both members; they see that a message was recalled.

original_days.label: Keep the original text of edited or recalled messages for admins (days, 0 = forever)
original_days.help: After this time the original text is erased from the database.

persian.label: Persian texts, Jalali dates and Persian digits (1 = on, 0 = use the site language files)
